newsitem.title: UK: BBV LatInvest launches new Carribean basin fund.
newsitem.headline: BBV LatInvest launches new Carribean basin fund.

text.p: BBV LatInvest said Friday it has launched a new investment fund to target Central America and the Caribbean.
Called the Quetzal Fund, it is the first investment fund to specialise in the region, according to BBV LatInvest, a unit of Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya.
Nobel peace prize winner and former president of Costa Rica Oscar Arias will head the fund's advisory committee.
The fund aims to raise a minimum of $20 million and the offer is capped at $50 million.

"We think that the region is interesting because the economic and political environment look increasingly attractive," Enrique Arias of BBV LatInvest told Reuters. "Company valuations are at a steep discount to comparative Latin American valuations."
The fund will have an initial focus on Barbados, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Jamaica, Panama, Puerto Rico and Trinidad & Tobago.
It will make investments in publicly-traded companies and companies seeking listings.
BBV LatInvest has initially structured the fund as closed-ended but shareholders can elect to make it open-ended after five years.
